purpose: Verify R02 and R03 chain wording, narrative scope, and the printed Ibn Kathir editor's Musnad Ahmad locators without treating those footnotes as an independent inspection of Musnad Ahmad.

source.edition: Tafsir al-Quran al-Azim, Sami ibn Muhammad al-Salama ed., Dar Taybah, 2nd ed., 1420/1999

controls: A printed editor footnote locator is not represented as a direct inspection of the cited Musnad Ahmad edition.
Route topology is separated from authentication and from proposition counting.
Narrative wording differences are preserved rather than harmonized.
No external grading is inferred or adopted.
No database write or publication is authorized.

route_reviews.chain_locator_ar: حدثنا عفان حدثنا حماد أخبرنا ثابت عن أنس
route_reviews.narrative_scope: The Prophet is given al-Kawthar; it is a flowing river not cut as a channel, with pearl domes on its banks, strongly fragrant musk soil, and pearl pebbles.
route_reviews.printed_tafsir_location: vol. 8, pp. 498-499; chain begins at p. 498 and report continues on p. 499
route_reviews.relation_to_checked_routes: Distinct below Anas from R01 al-Mukhtar family, R03 Humayd family, and R04 Qatada family.
route_reviews.proposition_handling: Corroborates the river description within claim I02; does not add a new proposition solely because its chain differs.
unresolved: Direct Musnad Ahmad edition text, modern hadith number, and edition reconciliation remain unchecked.

route_reviews.chain_locator_ar: حدثنا محمد بن أبي عدي عن حميد عن أنس
route_reviews.narrative_scope: The Prophet enters Paradise and sees a river whose banks have pearl tents; its flowing substance is fragrant musk; Gabriel identifies it as al-Kawthar.
route_reviews.relation_to_checked_routes: Distinct below Anas from R01 al-Mukhtar family, R02 Thabit family, and R04 Qatada family.
route_reviews.proposition_handling: Corroborates the river description within claim I02; its Paradise-entry setting is not equated with R01's revelation/doze episode.
unresolved: Direct Musnad Ahmad edition text, modern hadith number, and edition reconciliation remain unchecked.

explicit_disagreements_and_absences: R02 describes a flowing river not cut as a channel; R03 describes entry into Paradise and Gabriel's identification of the river.
Neither R02 nor R03 is the revelation/doze report preserved by R01.
The printed footnotes give al-Musnad (2/247) and (3/103), but no direct external Musnad witness was accessible in this bounded review.
No route authentication, grading, or new independent proposition is asserted.
The abridged stored English does not preserve complete R02 or R03 chains.
next_step: Reconcile R02 and R03 against an identified Musnad Ahmad edition or stable primary-record source. Until then retain both as distinct lower chains with external authentication unresolved.
